areas.area: Mac integration, security review and release evidence

last_completed: Began the encrypted .rdm area, the owner's stated next priority. The first defect found is in the interface rather than the container: the encrypted working store holds up to 256 unsaved drafts and RDMProjectSession returns all of them, but the UI restored only the newest into its single editor slot and reported that others were preserved with no way to reach them. Because discarding removes a draft from the store, the only route to an older preserved draft was to destroy the newer ones in front of it. The controller now keeps the full preserved list, refreshed after unlock, staging, checkpoint, discard and resolution, and the unlocked view renders a Preserved drafts card listing every draft with its path, size and last-written time, offering Open and Discard per draft. The draft in the editor is listed and marked rather than filtered, so the header count always matches the rows. Opening is refused while the editor holds text not yet confirmed in the working copy, and Discard is disabled while inconsistent copies await review. The mechanism relied on is already covered by testDiscardingDraftsClearsWorkingCopiesWhenNoneRemain, so no new core test was needed. Unverified source.

Still outstanding in the encrypted area per its contract: Mac CryptoKit parity, power-loss and APFS matrices, fuzz/sanitizer testing of the C parsers, independent cryptographic review, and Keychain device slots with recovery rotation. Also still unwalked: the original report's checklist items and the nine polish fixes from the two earlier passes.
